text:
elaine: quick heads up — ran into a reproducible bug in the Node sampleapp around key rotation. When both org and project keys are present the app kept using the org key, so rotating the project key didn't take effect and the user hit 403s.

mike: ah. which sampleapp version? can you drop a mini repro?

elaine: sampleapp node v0.9.2. repro is simple: export REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, then update REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY. node process still authorized as org key because the JS credential discovery checks REDWOOD_API_KEY before REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY. snippet:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_live_ABC
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_OLD
# rotate project key
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_NEW
node sampleapp.js # still sends org_live_ABC to API
```

sam: yikes. I thought precedence was unified. I recall Python using project-first.

mike: docs say project-first but impls diverged. Current: JS & Rust accidentally prefer the org key; Python does project-first. That mismatch is dangerous for rotation semantics.

terra: what about long-lived connections? If a stream reconnects during rotation does it pick up the new project key?

elaine: reconnect triggers discovery, but since JS discovery prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY the reconnect will re-auth as the org key unless the project key is explicitly provided via config. So rotation isn't reliable for streams.

dev-bot: opened issue devex/sdk-credentials#4287: "Env precedence parity + ensure streaming reconnect honors rotated project key" https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4287

mike: quick mitigation: 1) sampleapp short-term patch to prefer project key and log which key was used; 2) unify SDK precedence to project-first (allow override); 3) add onboarding note re: rotation and long-lived streams.

sam: for the sampleapp patch can we add a clear startup warning when both envs are set and link to docs? That should reduce support tickets.

elaine: drafting a tiny PR that prints "Using REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY" or "Using REDWOOD_API_KEY" and warns when both are present with a guidance URL. Will link PR here when ready.

mike: I'll take JS & Rust fixes. Sam owns the sampleapp PR + docs. Terra will add an e2e test to rotate keys mid-stream and assert reconnect uses the new project key.

terra: adding the e2e to the streaming test suite. will simulate rotation and check the reconnect identity.

sam: also suggesting a telemetry event `credential.shadow_detected` when both keys are set so we can measure prevalence. If widespread, we should notify affected customers.

mike: good plan. add telemetry as follow-up in #4287. prioritize parity patch for JS in next sprint.

elaine: thanks — once the sampleapp PR is merged I'll post a short note in #product and update the onboarding guide.

mike: great, thanks team. :thumbsup:
